original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Log Area Length raw value matches the approved System Event Log storage layout, bounds the header and data regions correctly, and remains stable after reboot without clearing or writing the log.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 15 records, preserve log area length, header/data offsets, access method, status, format and descriptor metadata, validate arithmetic/layout constraints against the approved implementation and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the event-log layout/baseline and reboot plan. Log clearing, event injection or firmware-log writes are excluded unless separately authorized and are unnecessary for this metadata case.
required_inputs: Expected raw/decoded Log Area Length and units
Expected Log Header Start Offset and Log Data Start Offset relationships
Platform event-log implementation, access method and status/format expectations
Policy for zero/unsupported values and multiple Type 15 records
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not follow the generic source instruction to clear dmesg/syslog/SEL merely to create a baseline; snapshot existing evidence read-only.
Do not write, erase or inject entries into the event log.
Preserve raw numeric values and validate both offsets lie within the area with the intended ordering; a decoded length alone is insufficient.
Do not equate Type 15 System Event Log metadata with BMC SEL capacity unless the platform map explicitly relates them.
Stop on invalid bounds, unsupported access semantics, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 15 metadata, validate raw length and cross-field bounds, optionally collect approved read-only log metadata and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not clear/write logs, inject events or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the Type 15 layout and any relationship to platform/BMC logs.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize any separate destructive log operation if ever required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but a length fragment cannot prove raw units or consistency with header/data offsets and access-method layout.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 structures and calculate header/data offset bounds and remaining data capacity against the raw Log Area Length per record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Area Length scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is not executed under the locked safety policy.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the raw area length and header/data offsets as one layout, preserve access/status/format context and compare stable metadata across reboot while snapshotting—not clearing—logs.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, event-log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Log Area Length and offset semantics, approved platform event-log layout and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw arithmetic bounds, implementation identity and evidence-preserving collection instead of isolated text plus unsafe generic clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for overlapping/out-of-range regions without reducing the original field check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Static metadata does not prove log media capacity is usable or that BMC SEL is the same store.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different area size/layout for a firmware release, but must version all related offsets/access semantics together and cannot claim original values passed; ordinary log growth across reboot is not metadata drift.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity and complete Type 15 layout baseline
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 raw/decoded record with length, header/data offsets, access method, status, format and descriptors
Per-record offset-bound/ordering/capacity calculations and optional read-only log correlation
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without log clearing

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The field intent is coherent; the generic clear-logs step is an unsafe nonessential preparation overridden by the locked evidence-preservation policy rather than an ambiguity in acceptance semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length and related layout fields are read-only and automatable; a missing project layout is readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw units, cross-field bound calculations and evidence-preserving log handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-clear/no-write and layout safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approved reboot/layout inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible size value from passing with out-of-range offsets and prevents destructive clearing of potentially relevant firmware/BMC evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 15 length and offsets are structured numeric metadata; with a platform baseline, exact extraction and bound/persistence checks are deterministic software operations.
